problem_type: Split UI-vs-Agent parameter resolution, single-shot patch lock, half-blind Turn-1 ambient context, and bloated non-strict tool schemas causing preventable Agent tool rejections
symptom: Over 70% of real-model Agent tool rejections came from host-derivable or deterministically snappable inputs: explicit modeId rejected for missing/synonymous taskKind, semantic aspectRatio (e.g. 9:16) or parameters.size rejected on pixel-enum models, out-of-step durationSec forcing blind retries, revise one shot per call blocking multi-shot revisions, serial first-error masking, Turn-1 model index omitting valid ratios/durations/slot caps and active subview focus, and redundant storyboard fields blocking strict sampling.
direct_cause: Agent drafting in writeVerbs, semanticGenerationCandidate, semanticAspectRatio, and generationAuthoredDuration enforced separate punitive checks instead of sharing the canvas parameter/mode kernel, while laneModelContext omitted Turn-1 model specs/focus and laneTools left pi native constrainedSampling unused.
class_root: Allowing the Agent write face to diverge from the UI node parameter kernel and shifting host-derivable invariants (modeId->taskKind, ratio->pixel geometry, nearest duration snap, storyboard visual carrier, batch patch iteration, grammar-constrained sampling) onto prompt prose and post-hoc rejection branches.
affected_population: All Agent draft_shots single-shot, multi-shot, storyboard anchor, and batch-revision calls
Turn-1 generation requests relying on saved default models or active canvas/subview focus
All strict-subset internal Agent lane tools under pi AgentHarness and third-party openai-compatible relays
entry_points: draft_shots create / append / multi-shot batch patch via laneVerbTransport -> mcpGenerationTools
Turn-1 system model index and user ambient focus via laneModelContext / laneDesktopInput / laneContextBudget
AgentHarnessTool assembly with native constrainedSampling in createLaneTools
internal_only_reason: All changes unify Nomi's internal Agent capability kernel with Nomi's own canvas archetype/parameter owners and wire already-installed @earendil-works/pi-ai constrained-sampling APIs inspected directly in local node_modules.
invariants: Explicit modeId authoritatively derives taskKind from the shared archetype mode owner across image and video models; invalid modeId still fails closed with mode_not_in_model.
Semantic aspect ratios (both top-level aspectRatio and direct ratio strings on pixel-enum controls) map deterministically to the model's legal pixel option via resolveAspectRatioGeometryChoice.

Out-of-step or out-of-range positive durationSec snaps deterministically to the nearest legal model option/bound (tie-breaking to shorter duration), persists identically across draft/node/card, and emits structured adjustments in the tool receipt; models with no duration parameter still refuse.

draft_shots supports atomic multi-shot batch revisions in one call, and both multi-shot create and batch patch scan all shots in one pass to report all genuine hard errors (such as missing shotId/assetId) together with zero partial writes.

Turn-1 ambient context provides default model valid ratios, duration ranges/enums, resolutions, and slot caps within <=350 tokens plus active surface/subview focus, while createLaneTools enables native json_schema constrainedSampling on every strict-compatible verb and prose field paths stay 100% locked to published schemas.

door_reduction.why_not: The 60 doors are existing layered callers across verb declaration/projection, transport translation, draft admission (create/extend/patch), storyboard subject/design adaptation, ambient context formatting (live + compaction), model provider compat, and AgentHarness tool assembly; rather than adding new parallel doors, every layer now delegates to the same shared mode/aspect-ratio/duration/strict-schema owners.

generality_proof: Mode-to-taskKind derivation reads everyBuiltInArchetype + modeTransportFor once for all built-in and vendor-specialized models; pixel-ratio resolution reuses resolveAspectRatioGeometryChoice across all enum/pixel controls; duration snapping works generically on any ParameterField enum or min/max range; constrainedSampling derives automatically via makeStrictJsonSchema for all present and future lane tools; prose-to-schema test scans all internal verbs.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single admission funnel normalizing mode, semantic/pixel aspectRatio, and snapped duration with structured adjustments across create, extend, and patch.
Authoritative modeId -> GenerationDefaultTaskKind derivation shared by shotTaskKind and statedShotTaskKind.
Single AgentHarnessTool factory deriving native json_schema constrainedSampling for all strict-compatible tools.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both single-shot and multi-shot create/extend route through normalizeAuthoredCandidate with noteAdjustment and full-batch error aggregation.
Canvas operation patch and document storyboard patch both accept atomic multi-shot patches, aggregate errors across all shots before writing, and return adjustments.
Turn-1 declared defaults carry compact ratio/duration/resolution/slot specs (<=350 tokens) and formatLaneAmbientFocus projects active surface/selection/subview focus.

recurrence.reason: Every new model archetype, multi-shot revision request, Turn-1 creation prompt, or verb prose edit hits these exact boundaries unless enforced structurally.
same_class_scan: Audited all 101 real-model tool rejections and R2 trajectories across writeVerbs, semanticGenerationCandidate, semanticAspectRatio, and generationAuthoredDuration
Scanned all 29 verbs with makeStrictJsonSchema to classify 26 strict-compatible verbs vs 3 open-record verbs

Scanned all 22 internal verbs' prose descriptions, promptGuidelines, JSON pointers, and examples against published JSON schemas (caught and fixed stage_shot setPieces[].kind and 2 walkthrough fixtures)

prevention.invariant: Agent drafting shares the canvas mode/ratio/duration resolution kernel, admits multi-shot revisions and full-batch error reporting atomically, injects Turn-1 model/focus facts, and locks verb prose and strict sampling at assembly.
prevention.failure_mode: Genuine hard errors (unknown model/mode, missing shotId/assetId, unsupported ratio or non-duration model) fail closed across the full batch with charged=false and actionable allowed values.
prevention.strategy: Delete single-shot revision lock and redundant editor-only storyboard fields in-place while keeping storyboard.carrier optional (defaulting omitted carrier to 'visual' and preserving explicit 'text'/'visual'), route mode/ratio/duration admission through shared owners with explicit adjustments, enrich Turn-1 ambient context, and lock prose-schema parity + constrainedSampling in CI.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed the revise-one-shot-per-call lock, redundant storyboard model-face fields, and punitive duration/pixel-ratio rejection branches in-place within their owning modules; no standalone file was deleted.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Per workspace no-download constraint, native constrainedSampling is enabled now on @earendil-works/pi-ai@0.85.1 for pure strict-subset internal tools (gated by explicit model compat.supportsStrictMode/supportsStrictTools so third-party openai-compatible relays never receive strict:true 400s) while pi 1.7.0 upgrade lands in a dedicated PR after user confirmation.
exit_criteria: Upgrade @earendil-works/pi-agent-core and @earendil-works/pi-ai to >=1.7.0 in a dedicated PR once user confirms package download
Re-evaluate constrainedSampling coverage on open-record verbs after upstream upgrade

migration: Existing persisted drafts, canvas nodes, and storyboard designs require zero data migration: storyboardSubjectFromCandidate defaults omitted carrier to 'visual' while preserving explicit 'visual'/'text' carriers intact through draft_shots, and single-shot patch wire calls remain byte-compatible alongside new batch patches.
residual_risks: Three verbs with open record dictionaries (draft_shots shots[].parameters, stage_shot actors[].anchors / edits[].value, and MCP-only try_model params) remain constrainedSampling=false because JSON Schema strict mode forbids open additionalProperties.
